title: [Shopify] Add cues for Skipped Records and API Errors on Activities page
summary: Two new cues on the Shopify Activities page display counts of skipped sync records and API errors, making background job issues visible without manually opening logs.
key_points: Added Skipped Records cue that counts records from background Shopify syncs and drills down to details
Added API Errors cue showing count of logged errors with red styling and drill-down to error logs
Both cues use FlowFields on the Shpfy Cue table for calculation
Addresses visibility gap where background job issues were invisible due to GuiAllowed restrictions
No breaking changes, purely additive cues following existing Shopify Activities patterns
